shop.sh.title: Shop
shop.sh.earnHow: Earn Light by meeting goals, opening chests and winning in Ranks.
shop.sh.weekSub: A league week in the top 3 wins these. They come back only after weeks.
shop.sh.limHow: Sold one week at a time
shop.sh.limSub: Gone at Friday's Maghrib, back in 12 weeks
shop.sh.stallSub: Three pieces at 30 % off, new ones every day
shop.sh.giftSent: Your gift is on its way to {name}
shop.sh.giftPiece: Choose a piece from the shop
shop.sh.giftNote: Up to 3 gifts a day. Your friend opens it as a chest.
shop.sh.lampNext: {n} Light more to spend for the next lamp
shop.sh.seasonSub: Seasonal pieces are never sold. They come to everyone who opens the app in their season, and stay for good.
shop.sh.powerSub: Kept for a day you miss.
shop.sh.charSub: Parts for your character, worn on the boards, in your room and in every moment.
shop.sh.roomSub: One piece in each place of your room.
shop.sh.lookSub: Shown beside your name on the boards.
shop.sh.wonSub: Never sold. Earned by streaks, badges and weeks in Ranks.
shop.sh.iconsSub: Wear one on your home screen instead of the theme icon.
shop.sh.full: You hold the most there can be
shop.sh.cantWear: Your character can’t wear this one. Try it on another look in the builder.
shop.sh.signIn: Sign in on Ranks to use it on the boards.
shop.sh.note: Light is never money and never a measure of reward with Allah.
shop.sh.why.char: Your character wears it on the boards, in your room and in every celebration.
shop.sh.why.room: It stays in your room, and friends see it when they visit.
shop.sh.why.look: Everyone in your league sees it beside your name, all week.
shop.sh.why.won: It can only be won, never bought, so it shows what you did.
shop.sh.why.season: It comes once a year. Earn it in its season and keep it for good.
shop.sh.why.freeze: A missed day will not put your flame out.
shop.sh.why.icon: Your home screen shows how far you have come.
